author: Diego Sandoval
title: Nic Claxton traded to Chicago Bulls
desc: Nic Claxton is being traded to the Chicago Bulls in a three-team deal that includes Julius Randle heading to Brooklyn.
impact: Claxton will join the Bulls as a part of a trade that also includes the No. 28 overall pick heading to Brooklyn, and the Timberwolves receiving the No. 33 pick. Claxton averaged 11.7 points, 6.9 rebounds and 1.1 blocks per game with the Nets last season. The 27-year-old will bring a strong paint presence to a Bulls team that has needed one for a while.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Julius Randle being traded to Brooklyn Nets
desc: Julius Randle is being traded to the Brooklyn Nets in a three-team trade that sends Nic Claxton to the Chicago Bulls.
impact: Randle and the No. 28 pick in the NBA Draft are heading to Brooklyn, while the Timberwolves will acquire the No. 33 overall pick from the Nets. Randle averaged 21.1 points, 6.7 rebounds and five assists per game last season for Minnesota, which could be a team to watch going forward as a roster shakeup seems to be in the works.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Amen Thompson only 'near untouchable' player on Rockets roster
desc: Amen Thompson is reportedly the only "near untouchable" player on the Rockets' roster.
impact: Houston doesn't appear to be actively shopping other players, but they're open to doing so in the right offer. It doesn't appear any other star players are available as of now outside of Giannis Antetokounmpo -- who is expected to land with either the Celtics or Rockets.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Mohamed Diawara intends to sign multi-year deal with Knicks
desc: Mohamed Diawara intends to sign a multi-year deal worth more than $10 million to return to the New York Knicks.
impact: Diawara was a second-round pick in the 2025 NBA Draft by the Knicks and will now be staying with the organization for the near future. The 21-year-old accumulated just 43 total minutes on the team's playoff run, but will look to continue to grow into a potential role player in the coming years.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Trae Young intends to sign 4-year, $212 million deal with Wizards
desc: Trae Young intends to sign a 4-year, $212 million contract to stay with the Washington Wizards.
impact: Young was traded to the Wizards midseason and has played just five games with the team. He declined his $49 million player option earlier in the offseason, but that proved to be the first step in securing a long-term deal with Washington. With Young locked down for the near future and the No. 1 overall pick in hand, the Wizards could be an interesting team to watch heading into next season.

author: Garrett Ball
title: Aaron Wiggins traded to Hawks
desc: Aaron Wiggins is being traded from the Thunder to the Atlanta Hawks for two second round picks.
impact: Wiggins was drafted by the Thunder in 2021 and has since won a championship with the team. He will now bring a veteran presence with plenty of playoff experience to a young Hawks team that is looking to improve after being the only team to last more than five games against the Knicks in their championship winning playoff run.

author: Ari Koslow
title: CJ McCollum signs one-year extension with Hawks
desc: CJ McCollum agreed to a one-year, $21 million contract extension with the Hawks.
impact: The deal also includes a trade kicker. McCollum commits to a new deal that keeps him out of free agency after Atlanta went 19-4 with him as a starter from February 22 through end of the regular season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jordan Goodwin intends to sign three-year deal to return to Suns
desc: Jordan Goodwin intends to sign a three-year, $19 million deal to return to the Phoenix Suns.
impact: The contract includes a player option in the third season. Goodwin made the Suns roster out of training camp and worked his way into a key reserve role, which he'll figure to remain in.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope exercises player option with Grizzlies
desc: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope will exercise his player option for the 2026-27 season.
impact: Caldwell-Pope's season ended early last year after he injured his finger and underwent surgery. He will remain off the fantasy radar.

author: Garrett Ball
title: Collin Gillespie to sign a four-year, $48 million deal with Suns
desc: Collin Gillespie intends to sign a four-year, $48 million deal with the Phoenix Suns. The former UDFA lands a massive deal.
impact: Gillespie essentially doubled his production from the 2024-25 season by going for 12.7 points, 4.1 rebounds, and 4.6 assists per game in the 25-26 season. He should be a regular rotation player for the Suns next season.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: D'Angelo Russell exercises player option with Wizards for 2026-27 season
desc: D'Angelo Russell opted into his $6-million player option for the 2026-27 season with the Washington Wizards on Friday.
impact: Russell was traded to Washington last season in the Anthony Davis trade, but he never suited up for the team. His future with the Wizards has always been a question mark, and there is still a chance he could be traded even though he has opted into his player option.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Austin Reaves to draw interest from Pistons if he reaches UFA
desc: The Pistons are reportedly expected to show interest in Austin Reaves if he reaches unrestricted free agency.
impact: Reaves is expected to decline his $14.9 million player option for the 2026-27 season. It remains unclear how much interest the Lakers will have in re-signing him.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Isaiah Stewart available for trade
desc: Isaiah Stewart is reportedly available in a trade this offseason.
impact: Stewart averaged double digit scoring for the third time in four seasons this past year. He has one more year left before reaching a club option in his deal.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Derrick White drawing interest from Timberwolves
desc: The Timberwolves reportedly have strong interest in Derrick White.
impact: White still has two more years left in his deal before he reaches a player option. This would have to be a trade this offseason, likely more so if Boston acquires Giannis Antetokounmpo.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Trey Murphy III drawing interest from Celtics
desc: The Celtics are showing interest in Trey Murphy III.
impact: Murphy could be a "plan B" for Boston if it can't land Giannis Antetokounmpo. He is coming off back-to-back seasons averaging 21 points per game for New Orleans.
